title: Chapter 1128
text:
After the three Universal Civilizations completed their mission, they informed the various organizations in the Ancient Star Desert to reactivate the quantum network. Being disconnected for less than half a day brought huge economic losses to the entire Star Field. The various organizations were all curious about what the three Universal Civilizations had done during this time.

With the intelligence gathered, they quickly figured out the actions of the group of Beyond Grade As and were all shocked.

The Supercluster Civilizations all suffered from PTSD, and the Star Arc Civilization had been paying attention to this. After learning of this, the upper echelons held another meeting.

"So, this is how the Virtual Mutiny Virus works. If it's leaked out, who knows how many people will die … Unfortunately, we were kept in the dark, and the core has already been destroyed by Black Star."

Many upper echelons were afraid and regretful.

They were afraid of the threat of the Virtual Mutiny Virus itself. They originally thought that the three Universal Civilizations had the situation under control, but they did not expect it to be an illusion. If they did not find out about the virus core, disaster would have swept across the entire universe.

They regretted that they did not know the goal of the three Universal Civilizations beforehand. In order to observe the situation, they obediently cooperated with the operation. In the end, the virus core was destroyed by the three Universal Civilizations, and the Virtual Mutiny Virus technology became extinct.

Because what was done could not be undone, the three Universal Civilizations did not continue to hide the information.

"Luckily, Black Star destroyed the virus core. If the three Universal Civilizations obtained this information weapon technology, our situation would be even worse." An upper echelon heaved a sigh of relief.

"You're wrong. Black Star destroying the virus core will do more harm than good to us. Even if the technology is obtained by the three Universal Civilizations, they won't dare use it recklessly in order to maintain order. There's still a gap between us and them. However, to us, this technology is enough to threaten the three Universal Civilizations, and it can quickly close the gap. It's a trump card against the three Universal Civilizations. Now that the technology is gone, we've lost this opportunity forever, "someone retorted.

"If only the Mecha Empire succeeded …"

Many people sighed.

They hoped that Manison would succeed. In order to maintain their advantage, the Mecha Empire would most likely collude with the Supercluster Alliance. This way, they would have the opportunity to find a way to make a deal with the Mecha Empire and obtain the virus technology.

But now, this hope of a comeback had been crushed by Black Star. They couldn't help but beat their chests and stamp their feet in regret.

"Black Star, this guy is really …" One of the higher-ups wanted to say something but hesitated. He didn't know how to describe Han Xiao's actions and finally said, "What a waste."

Looking at the upper echelons with different expressions, the leader of the Star Arc Civilization said solemnly, "The result can no longer be changed. What we need to think about is how to deal with the current situation."

"The battle between the three Universal Civilizations and the Supercluster Alliance is inevitable in the Flickering World. What we lack the most is time to prepare. Originally, the Intelligent Plague took up the energy of the three Universal Civilizations, so the longer we wait, the better. However, now that the disaster is about to end, the three Universal Civilizations will soon have the time to deal with us," someone said with a low voice.

"The virus core was discovered by Black Star and destroyed by him. Because of his actions, the time taken by the three Universal Civilizations to deal with the Intelligent Plague has been greatly reduced … Tsk, it's Black Star again!"

Most of the upper echelons were very dissatisfied. Black Star was the reason why Traveler was exposed in the past. Now, it was Black Star who ruined their plans.

However, being angry was one thing. They couldn't afford to keep a low profile right now, so there was no way they would go and deal with Black Star.

The leader of the Star Arc Civilization flipped through the intelligence report and suddenly said, "Black Star and the Mecha Empire had a disagreement on how to deal with the virus core. The two of them fought and almost officially broke off their relationship. What do you guys think?"

"According to the battle report, Black Star and the Mecha Empire fought to a draw …" An intelligence officer frowned and said, "If it was Black Star's main body that came, there would still be a chance, but both of them are doppelgangers. Our artificial intelligence has built countless models, and the analysis shows that when the Lord's Doppelgangers fight, Black Star's chance of winning is lower than 0.0027%. He's still not a match for the Mecha Empire. The draw is because the other Beyond Grade As took sides, so they must have received instructions from behind the scenes. Therefore, it can be determined that the three Universal Civilizations want to create an equal to compete with the Mecha Empire."

The leader of the Star Arc Civilization narrowed his eyes and said, "This means that after this battle, Black Star and the Mecha Empire have parted ways. Black Star will be supported, and the Mecha Empire will be suppressed. There might be some opportunities in this …"

"You mean …"

The leader of the Star Arc Civilization slowly said, "The Mecha Empire has been in operation for many years and is already in a semi-independent state. They have basically gotten rid of their dependence on the three Universal Civilizations, but even so, they will still need some external help when facing the three Universal Civilizations. And this help … we can provide it."

Everyone's eyes sparkled, and they nodded.

Everyone had times when they needed help, and the Mecha Empire was a powerful figure. Now that they were in a difficult situation and were not trusted by the three Universal Civilizations, if the Supercluster Alliance helped them, they might have a chance to secretly cooperate with them.

This way, to a certain extent, it would prevent the Beyond Grade As from forming a new cooperative relationship with the three Universal Civilizations, and it would also cause trouble for Black Star, who often found trouble with them.

…

On a desolate planet in the Primeval Star River, in a secret base hidden underground.

Lightning flashed in the darkness, and a pair of glowing eyes opened, reflecting the silhouette of a person sitting cross-legged on the ground. This figure stood up, and the sound of cloth rubbing against each other could be heard. The next moment, he turned on the lights in the room, revealing his true appearance. It was Manison's original body.

After falling out with the three Universal Civilizations, he deactivated [Lord's Descent] and did not contact anyone for the time being. He had been secretly operating his organizations throughout the various Star Fields, preparing to deal with the suppression of the three Universal Civilizations.

Manison knew better than anyone what the three Universal Civilizations would do to him.

"This day is much earlier than I expected …"

Manison exhaled softly. Then, his tone became a little unhappy as he growled in a deep voice.

"Black Star, you brat, you ruined my plan!"

Black Star, this bastard. If he had not exposed the existence of the virus core, he would not have had to take such a risk.

Manison had also discovered clues about the virus core. His plan was concealed, and he did not report it to the three Universal Civilizations. This way, he would have the opportunity to take the Virtual Mutiny Virus for himself, secretly obtain this technology, and make a fortune.

The way he saw it, Black Star also had such an opportunity and even had more clues than him. However, in order to reduce the damage caused by the disaster, Black Star had actually shared information with the three Universal Civilizations!

If not for this, he would not have had to go against the three Universal Civilizations in front of everyone. If he missed this opportunity, he would never be able to obtain the Virtual Mutiny Virus technology again.

The root of all this was Black Star!

He had taken such a huge risk, but in the end, that bastard Black Star actually crushed the virus core. Everyone's efforts were for nothing.

Even now, whenever Manison thought of the scene of Han Xiao crushing the virus core, his heart would ache.

The reason he dared to take the risk of the three Universal Civilizations falling out with him to snatch the virus core was naturally because it was worth it.

He was a top Virtual Mechanic, and he had an AI civilization in his hands. If he obtained the full set of Virtual Mutiny Virus technology and improved it, it would produce an intense chemical reaction. With his own deterrence, he would be able to become the new pole of the universe.

Everything else aside, as long as he created a core in his own artificial intelligence cultivation room, cultivated generations of viruses in advance, and then released them to permeate the entire universe, he would be everywhere!

At that time, this Intelligent Plague would be nothing compared to him!

If the three Universal Civilizations obtained the technology, there would still be a chance. Manison might even take the risk of being discovered and sneak in to steal the technology.

However, now, the opportunity to reach the peak was destroyed by Black Star. Manison wished he could turn Han Xiao into a 'Felon' on the spot.

Manison shook his head. At this point, there was no point in thinking too much. It was more important to deal with the situation at hand.

"After this, Radiance and I will be even more distant. The three Universal Civilizations will try to reduce my wings. Fortunately, I've been trying my best to get rid of them over the years and have my own independent channels. I've also cultivated a large number of hidden organizations, and many businesses can be easily operated in the dark …"

A long time ago, Manison felt that he would be independent one day, so he had to be prepared. Thus, he dared to take a gamble today because he was not afraid of the three Universal Civilizations falling out with him.

Furthermore, with the current situation, the two sides were not completely on opposite sides. He still had to pretend to be polite. The three Universal Civilizations were still wary of him.

Manison had expected this risk before he took action, so he took the opportunity to reveal a little of his trump card. The tens of millions of Lord's Avatars were enough to make the three Universal Civilizations hesitate. As long as they could not find his main body, he could keep appearing. He had already prepared for this outcome.

"The three Universal Civilizations want to support Black Star to compete with me. I'll probably lose Radiance's funding, so I'll have to find some new friends …"

Manison narrowed his eyes and pondered.

…

Han Xiao and the others had already completed their work, so they could not help in the overall rectification. They only needed to watch the three Universal Civilizations perform.

After getting rid of the virus core, the three Universal Civilizations no longer had anything to worry about. The disaster relief efficiency of the three Universal Civilizations suddenly increased, and they used the antivirus set to restart the previous antivirus plan.

Without the virus core, the first-generation Virtual Mutiny Virus was leaderless. The three Universal Civilizations scanned and locked onto the nodes before eliminating them at the same time. They then immediately launched a dedicated firewall. The virus in the Ancient Star Desert was quickly dealt with on a large scale, and the Intelligent Plague was quickly rectified.

It had been a few months since the outbreak of the Intelligent Plague, and the Star Field had been sealed. The entire universe was extremely concerned about the situation in the Ancient Star Desert. As the news was sealed for a long time, more rumors spread in the universe, and some people started to spread panic.

Now that the disaster was under control, the three Universal Civilizations finally made an announcement to the entire universe, giving the citizens of Galaxy some peace of mind.

In the announcement, the three Universal Civilizations added the entire process of hunting down the virus core.

As soon as the official announcement was released, it immediately attracted the attention of countless organizations in the explored universe.

Han Xiao's achievements were also spread rapidly across the entire universe along with the intentional publicity of the three Universal Civilizations, causing a huge response!
